messages:
Emilia (CS): FYI — Fintra submitted a SIG/CAIQ with a hard due date next Fri. They called out three blocking items: HSM attestation (they want a vendor-signed cert), audit log samples for export flows, and a reproducible 401 seen during their SIG export tests. Link to form: https://docs.redwood.com/fintra/sig-attachment (customer-provided). Can we triage?
Sam (SRE): adding context — I saw a short 401 spike at ~2026-03-02T14:02:11Z on our gateway for customer org fintra-prod. Token failures coincided with an autoscaler event. Need request ids and sample payload from their test to reproduce.
Helena (Security): what exactly do they mean by HSM attestation? Usually we provide the HSM vendor cert + KMS key import logs and rotation policy. We can also provide our customer-facing attestation package but may need legal stamp for some banks.
Priya (Eng): Sam, can you paste one of the failing request IDs? Quick repro curl that I can run locally would help. Also, did they run the SIG export against Dedicated or Hosted? Behavior differs.
Sam (SRE): here's a sample entry from the gateway logs (redacted):
```
request_id=01F7X2ABCDZKZQ8YZ0T3 user=fintra-prod path=/v1/sig/export status=401 reason=token_expired upstream=kms-rotate-2026-03-02
```
Repro curl they used (customer provided):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/sig/export -d '{"format":"json"}'
```
When token hits expiry during a long export we returned 401 instead of streaming a controlled error.
Emilia (CS): customer says they were on Hosted with a long-running export of ~15m. They saw a billing spike right after — unexpected token churn. They want: 1) a repro playbook we can hand them, 2) audit log samples showing key rotation/timestamps, 3) HSM attestation artifact. Due date: 5 business days from now.
Helena (Security): OK. Action items for security artifacts: I can assemble a HSM attestation bundle: vendor cert, signature chain, and our KMS access audit for the past 90 days. I will need approval from Legal for stamping; can Legal fast-track?
Priya (Eng): For the 401 repro — I'll draft a small test harness that simulates a long export and token rotation to see failure modes. Plan: run a background token rotation while streaming export; assert we handle refresh or produce graceful abort with error code 429/503 instead of 401.
Sam (SRE): I'll correlate billing records to request_id to see whether retries caused the spike. Also will check whether our autoscaler triggered reboots of pods handling long-lived streams. If so, we need a mitigation: session-affinity or reconnect semantics.
Emilia (CS): Customer asked for an example audit log snippet showing KMS key usage sequence with timestamps. Helena, can you extract a sanitized example? They prefer CSV with cols: time,event,request_id,key_id,actor.
Helena (Security): Yes. I'll pull a sanitized sample and attach. Expected ETA: 24 hours for the bundle (attestation + sanitized logs). Legal check may add 48h if they want signed stamp.
Priya (Eng): Quick note — code snippet to force token expiry for repro (do NOT run in prod):
```
# simulate short-lived token
export RW_TOKEN=$(get-temp-token --ttl 10s)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN" https://staging.redwood.com/v1/sig/export -d '{"format":"json"}'
```
This reproduces a mid-export expiry and shows the 401 behavior locally.
Sam (SRE): deploy-bot shows a config rollout touching keystore rotation 2026-03-02 14:00:00Z — tag: keystore-autoclaim-v2. Could be related.
deploy-bot: deploy keystore-autoclaim-v2 -> success (id: deploy-8842)
Emilia (CS): OK let's map owners and timelines: Helena to assemble attestation + sample logs (24h). Priya to produce repro harness and a short doc (48h). Sam to investigate billing link and autoscaler correlation (48h). I'll prepare a customer update acknowledging receipt and ETA.
Helena (Security): note for customer-facing attestation: include description of HSM vendor (YubiHSM / Thales), our KMS rotation cadence, and the import policy. Also include the list of cryptographic modules and FIPS certs.
Priya (Eng): I'll also add a recommended mitigation: chunked export with checkpointed resume tokens so long exports don't rely on single ephemeral bearer token. That can be a best-practice note for their SIG response.
Sam (SRE): If we can reproduce quickly, we should offer a short-lived workaround: advise them to increase token TTL for export jobs or run via a service account with refresh capability (we can provide how-to).
Emilia (CS): Customer asked whether providing logs will expose other customer data — Helena, confirm sanitized examples will scrub PII.
Helena (Security): yes. I'll redact identifiers and provide mapping table separately under NDA if needed.
Emilia (CS): I'll send initial reply now: "Received. We are investigating 401 spike, audit logs and HSM attestation; ETA 48hrs for repro + logs, 72hrs if Legal stamp needed. Will share sanitized samples soon." :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): leaving a checklist here: 1) correlate request_ids to billing 2) check autoscaler events 3) repro in staging 4) prepare mitigation note.
Priya (Eng): putting PR link for repro harness in thread once ready.
Helena (Security): uploading attestation bundle to secure share: https://files.redwood.com/safe/fintra-attest-2026-03-02 (internal only).
Emilia (CS): thanks all — I'll update the customer and keep this thread for status. If Legal needs to jump in, ping me.
Sam (SRE): FYI — if anyone sees more 401s for other customers around that time, add to this thread.
Emilia (CS): closing the initial triage — will reopen if new findings.
